verifiedBehavior: Exact accepted catalog text and derived identity survive a new store and a full browser-process restart in real OPFS. The browser test uses public synthetic empty catalog metadata, then persists a newer revision containing one synthetic revoked receipt identity.

Durable newer authority precedes live refresh; an expired newer revision remains a rollback barrier and cannot be replaced by older still-unexpired installation metadata. Same-revision equivocation, older issue times and changed catalog identity reject.

Current fetched metadata becomes runtime authority only after exact durable readback. Failed or unreadable storage suppresses older RAM fallback and active-model admission; boot's ignored return value does not bypass the empty current-entry view.

Atomic write acknowledgement failures and postcommit lock errors are resolved by exact readback; unreadable disposition is indeterminate. Competing writers converge on the newest admissible revision under the existing exclusive lock.

Explicit Refresh can reopen saved composition bytes after current authority renewal without invoking a download. Revoked, absent or busy cases do not activate; cancellation releases the restore command without invoking companion cancellation.

A corrupt cached static entry rejects its request and is the only entry evicted. Offline retry remains failed; a later online request admits only pinned expected bytes. Model/catalog/private bytes remain outside the static CacheStorage closure.

Actual production worker and WASM initialize online with service workers blocked, online with them active, and after a fresh browser process goes offline. This validates runtime availability and initialization, not model generation.

limits.offlineLifetime: Accepted authority must still be within its actual valid_until_utc and the existing maximum 24-hour age. An expired installation needs a successful online authority refresh; this work does not promise indefinite offline use.
limits.storageUnavailable: Authority read/write failures fail closed. A fresh visitor without working OPFS cannot automatically acquire or activate a model through this path.
limits.revocationDiscovery: Offline clients cannot learn unseen remote revocations. A durably accepted revocation is retained across restart, including after expiry, as a rollback barrier.
limits.remainingProductEvidence: A qualified real model, real installed-model conversation through Refresh/offline return, and coherent public publication remain separate gates owned by the parent task.
